description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the student market this four bedroom flat on West Jesmond Avenue.

This ground-floor flat is ideally located close to West Jesmond Metro station, the Lonsdale pub and Sainsbury-s, offering excellent convenience for student living.

Recently refurbished and well maintained throughout, the property features four generously sized double bedrooms, laminate flooring throughout and a good-sized living room, providing plenty of space for relaxing and socialising. The contemporary bathroom is fitted with a modern shower cubicle, adding to the property-s practical appeal.

Early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment. To arrange an appointment, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team!
